== Missing data ==
The Players Committee cardlist at res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set27Type.html still listed the six 24 August 2026 preview cards when the full set was dested (checked 17 October 2026). The virtual-slips index still labeled the PDF "Set 27 Preview - released August 24, 2026". No forum.starwarsccg.org "Virtual Set 27 is Now Live" thread was found on High Quality Custom V-Slips. Wayback captures of the @swccg 10 October 2026 announcement and of swccg-card-json sets.json were not confirmed at dest time.

== Possibly faulty data ==
swccg-card-json Light.json lore for Sacrifice For Something Bigger front has "t11he"; the back lore is "the". The wiki uses "the".

== Build notes ==
Full list from swccgpc/swccg-card-json Light.json / Dark.json, set 227 (28 cards + Qui-Gon Jinn (V) (ALT) as 227_29). sets.json date_release 2026-10-09, size 28. Holotable Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light and Virtual27-Dark hold the GIFs. @swccg announced the set on 10 October 2026. [[Geonosis: Petranaki Arena]] is Virtual Block 9 Light; [[Geonosis: Petranaki Arena (Dark)]] is Virtual Block 9 Dark; the Virtual Set 27 site is [[Geonosis: Petranaki Arena (Virtual Set 27)]]. Preview leftover titles [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27) (2)]] and [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V) (Virtual Set 27)]] redirect to the canonical pages.
